title: m-Contiguity Distance
summary: In this paper, we systematically develop the $m$-contiguity distance between simplicial maps as a discrete approximation framework for homotopical complexity in the category of simplicial complexes. We construct an increasing sequence of invariants that approximate the contiguity distance from below. We prove that $m$-contiguity distance is invariant under strong homotopy equivalence and that $m$-contiguity distance coincides with the usual contiguity distance provided that the dimension of the domain simplicial complex is $m$.
